meta.title: lagar – current Swedish law, without the version maze
meta.description: Search and read Swedish acts and ordinances in their current wording. Free, no account, open source.
hero.title: Current Swedish law, without the version maze
hero.lead: Search and read acts and ordinances in their current wording. Free, no account needed.
hero.independent: Independent project. Not a government service.
why.title: Why lagar
why.p1: Swedish law is public, but reading it is harder than it should be. An act is amended again and again, and the wording that applies today is spread across the original text and every change since. Official sources are complete but built for people who already know where to look.
why.p2: lagar puts the current wording of each law in one clean place, readable on a phone, free and without an account. Every law is a plain text file in an open repository, built from official open data, so anyone can check where a text came from, reuse it, or help improve it.
inside.title: What is in lagar
inside.lead: Norms are arranged in layers, from the fundamental laws down. The first layers are already here, more are coming.

open.title: Open source
open.p1: Every norm is a Markdown file in the repository. A collector fetches the texts from official sources, and a static JSON API powers the web app. Everything is free under the MIT licence.
open.p2: Android and iOS apps are on the way. Until then, the web app works in any modern browser, on phones too.
